steps.title: The mixer
steps.text: Each strip is a channel: fader, pan, mute and solo, its inserts and its sends. Right-click a strip for its Strip, Listen and Mixer View menus.

steps.title: Returns
steps.text: A return channel takes sends from other channels - a reverb or delay shared by many tracks. Each send has its own level and pan.

steps.title: Groups
steps.text: VCA groups move many faders at once. Groups can sit inside other groups and choose whether their level, mute and solo reach their members.

steps.title: Devices
steps.text: The selected channel's devices show here as cards, with the rack's macro knobs. Right-click a device in a rack to insert another beside it, copy it or compare two settings.
